high_level_description: This image depicts a surreal and eerie scene set against a dark, starry background, suggesting a night sky. The central focus is on several tall, vertical green beams of light that extend upwards from the bottom of the frame to the top. Each beam appears to be emanating from a circular platform at its base, which resembles a flying saucer or UFO. The green beams are illuminated with a glowing, neon-like quality, creating a stark contrast with the dark surroundings. Within each beam, there are small, black silhouettes of human figures.
